issue.title: Truthful %auto: P0 autonomy safety tales
issue.description: No %auto spelling silently grants more than it says, pressing A to turn auto off really turns it off, epic phase and land workers park nested epic plans for a human instead of launching them, and the docs, the macros.md memory row, and /sase_questions describe the behavior that actually ships. The three P0 task beads (sase-1hg, sase-15s, sase-1hh) are closed when the epic lands.
